Cyril, *Myst.* 1.4 — “the West is the region of sensible darkness”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.436 — “For as darkness is dispelled by light, and black disappears as whiteness is spread over it, so the old man also disappears”
Ambrose, *De Sacr.* 1.6.22 — “who scattered the shadows of unbelief, and poured the light of truth and spiritual grace on human hearts”

04:descent-ascent.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:descent-ascent.label: Going down, coming up
04:descent-ascent.def: The vertical movement of going down (water, earth, Hades) and coming back up (life, heaven), by Christ and in baptism.
04:descent-ascent.christ: Christ goes down first (into the Jordan, into Hades) and brings others up with Him.
where: Cyril, *Cat.* 3.12 — “Having gone down dead in sins, thou comest up quickened in righteousness.”
Cyril, *Cat.* 14.18 — “who descended into hell alone, but ascended thence with a great company”
Cyril, *Myst.* 2.4 — “descended three times into the water, and ascended again”
Irenaeus, *AH* 5.21.1 — “as our species went down to death through a vanquished man, so we may ascend to life again through a victorious one”
Cyril, *Cat.* 3.5 — “for first he crosses the Jordan, then in a chariot mounts the heaven.”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.69 — “that He might bring the Spirit from above, and exalt man to heaven”
Ambrose, *De Sacr.* 1.5.18 — “But Christ descended first, the Spirit followed.”

04:heaven-earth-axis.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:heaven-earth-axis.label: Above and below
04:heaven-earth-axis.def: What is above gives its quality to what is below; earthly signs come first and carry heavenly effects.
04:heaven-earth-axis.christ: Christ is "He who comes from the realms above" (Tertullian, *Bapt.* 10).
where: Tertullian, *Bapt.* 4 — “an underlying material substance should catch the quality of that which overhangs it”
Tertullian, *Bapt.* 3 — “the material substance which governs terrestrial life acts as agent likewise in the celestial.”
Tertullian, *Bapt.* 10 — “"He who is from the earth speaketh concerning the earth; He who comes from the realms above is above all;"”
Ambrose, *De Sacr.* 1.4.12 — “he who passes through this font, that is from earthly to heavenly things”
Origen, *DP* 4.1.13 (Gk.) — “of what heavenly things the Jews "according to the flesh" served as an example and a shadow”

04:figure-to-truth.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:figure-to-truth.label: Type to antitype (shadow to body)
04:figure-to-truth.def: The time-axis from the earlier, bodily figure to the later, spiritual reality it foreshadows; the later is greater.
04:figure-to-truth.christ: The reality the figures point to is Christ and His sacraments (Irenaeus, *AH* 4.26.1).
where: Tertullian, *Bapt.* 5 — “according to the rule by which things carnal are always antecedent as figurative of things spiritual.”
Cyril, *Myst.* 1.3 — “Now turn from the old to the new, from the figure to the reality.”
Cyril, *Myst.* 2.5 — “our imitation was in a figure, and our salvation in reality.”
Cyril, *Myst.* 3.6 — “To them however these things happened in a figure, but to you not in a figure, but in truth”
Ambrose, *De Myst.* 8.49b — “light is better than shadow, truth than a figure”
Ambrose, *De Sacr.* 2.1.2 — “And the mere figure helps us, since it is the herald of reality.”
Ambrose, *De Sacr.* 1.6.20 — “to them in a figure, but to us in reality.”
Origen, *DP* 4.1.11 (Lat.) — “the spiritual law itself (which has a shadow of good things to come)”
Irenaeus, *AH* 4.26.1 — “a treasure, hid indeed in a field, but brought to light by the cross of Christ”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.282 — “The thing is, I think, a dark saying, a shadow of what should come.”

04:well.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:well.label: The well (meeting place of bride and water)
04:well.def: A well in the wilderness where life-saving water is given and where brides are found.
04:well.christ: Christ is the stone on the well and Jacob, who opens it to the Church's flock (Gregory).
where: Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.261 — “an angel unexpectedly appears, and shows her a well of living water, and drawing thence, she saves Ishmael.”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.269 — “a marriage that was to produce the race of Christ had its beginning and its first covenant in water”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.272 — “for a type of all those impious men of later days who hindered the grace of Baptism”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.280 — “But Jacob alone rolls away the stone, and waters the flocks of his spouse.”

04:stone-cut-without-hands.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:stone-cut-without-hands.label: The stone (on the well; from the mountain)
04:stone-cut-without-hands.def: A stone cut without hands, read as Christ born of a virgin; also the mountain refuge.
04:stone-cut-without-hands.christ: It is Christ, born of a virgin without a human father (Gregory).
where: Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.282 — “For what is the stone that is laid but Christ Himself?”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.285 — “"A stone was cut out without hands," that is, Christ was born without a man.”
Cyril, *Myst.* 1.8 — “escape to the mountain, to Jesus Christ, that stone hewn without hands, which has filled the world.”

04:holy-mountain.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:holy-mountain.label: Mountain of refuge (Christ; the Church)
04:holy-mountain.def: The mountain to flee to from judgment (Lot), read as Christ; elsewhere the Church.
where: Cyril, *Myst.* 1.8 — “Was not he himself saved with his daughters, when he had gained the mountain”
Cyril, *Myst.* 1.8 — “escape to the mountain, to Jesus Christ, that stone hewn without hands, which has filled the world.”
Cyril, *Myst.* 3.7 — “now he calls the Church a mountain elsewhere also”
Ambrose, *De Sacr.* 2.1.1 — “he bade the water rise even above the mountains.”

04:bride.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:bride.label: The bride (Church / soul)
04:bride.def: The Church, or the baptized soul, prepared, washed and adorned for Christ the Bridegroom.
04:bride.christ: The bride is Christ's body, and one speaker can be both (Tyconius Rule 1).
where: Cyril, *Cat.* 3.1 — “let the souls that are to be united to the spiritual Bridegroom make themselves ready.”
Cyril, *Cat.* 3.2 — “Begin at once to wash your robes in repentance, that when called to the bride-chamber ye may be found clean.”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.* (closing) — “the Adorner of the bride is Christ”
Augustine, *DDC* 3.31.44 — “"He hath decked me as a bridegroom with ornaments, and adorned me as a bride with jewels"”
Augustine, *DDC* 2.6.7 — “the Church, when it is being praised under the figure of a beautiful woman”
Augustine, *DDC* 3.32.45 — “"I am black, but comely, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon."”

04:bridegroom.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:bridegroom.label: The Bridegroom
04:bridegroom.def: Christ as the one who invites, washes and adorns the bride, and who also separates the unworthy guests.
where: Cyril, *Cat.* 3.2 — “For the Bridegroom invites all without distinction, because His grace is bounteous”
Cyril, *Cat.* 3.2 — “but the same Bridegroom afterwards separates those who have come in to the figurative marriage.”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.* (closing) — “the Adorner of the bride is Christ”
Ambrose, *De Myst.* 7.37 — “But Christ, beholding His Church, for whom He Himself, as you find”

04:captive-maid.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:captive-maid.label: The captive girl (the Gentile Church)
04:captive-maid.def: A captive foreign girl who points her master to the prophet and the healing water; read as the Gentile Church.
04:captive-maid.christ: Indirect. She leads people to the prophet and to the water of grace.
where: Ambrose, *De Myst.* 3.18 — “She is the congregation gathered out of the Gentiles, that is, the Church of God held down of old by the captivity of sin”
Ambrose, *De Sacr.* 2.3.8 — “one who had the likeness of the Church, and exhibited a figure of it”
Ambrose, *De Sacr.* 2.3.8 — “For the people of the nations was captive.”

04:fish.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:fish.label: Little fishes born in water
04:fish.def: Believers as fish, born in water after the pattern of Christ the ICHTHUS, who live only by staying in the water.
where: Tertullian, *Bapt.* 1 — “we, little fishes, after the example of our IChThUS Jesus Christ, are born in water”
Tertullian, *Bapt.* 1 — “nor have we safety in any other way than by permanently abiding in water”
Augustine, *DDC* 3.32.45 — “the good fish and the bad are for the time mixed up in the one net.”

04:water-chain.work: Church Fathers in the Patrista corpus (ANF/NPNF translations)
04:water-chain.label: The water series as one shape
04:water-chain.def: The Fathers' master series of waters: creation → flood → Red Sea → Marah/rock → Jordan → Christ's baptism → font. Each one is a figure of baptism.
04:water-chain.texts: Gen 1:2; Gen 7–8; Exod 14–17; Josh 3–4; 2 Kgs 5; Matt 3; John 3:5; 1 Cor 10:1-4; 1 Pet 3:20-21.
04:water-chain.christ: Christ is at the centre of the series: He sanctifies the Jordan and every water after it, and water flows from His side.
where: Tertullian, *Bapt.* 9 — “How many, therefore, are the pleas of nature, how many the privileges of grace” ... “the figures, the preparations, the prayers, which have ordained the sanctity of water?”
Cyril, *Cat.* 3.5 — “The water was the beginning of the world, and Jordan the beginning of the Gospel tidings”
Ambrose, *De Sacr.* 2.3.9 — “thou hast a third kind when the fathers were baptized in the Red Sea; thou hast a fourth kind in the pool”
Gregory, *Bapt. Chr.*, l.243 — “the ancient Scripture everywhere prefigured the likeness of our regeneration”

05:heaven-and-earth.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:heaven-and-earth.label: Heaven (principle) / earth (matter)
05:heaven-and-earth.def: The basic polarity of reality. Heaven is invisible meaning, principle and identity. Earth is tangible matter, multiplicity and potential.

05:multiplicity-unity.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:multiplicity-unity.label: The one and the many
05:multiplicity-unity.def: Movement between scattered particulars below and one gathering identity above. Ascent gathers into unity, and falling scatters into multiplicity.
05:multiplicity-unity.texts: Gen 1 (kinds and seeds); Acts 1–2 icon (one, mother, twelve) per Jonathan's ascension icon
05:multiplicity-unity.christ: In the Ascension icon, Christ above is the one and the apostles below are the many (Jonathan, EP 206)

05:vertical-layers.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:vertical-layers.label: Light, air, water, earth
05:vertical-layers.def: A four-tier vertical cosmos. Tiers rise from heavy, dark and many (earth) to light, bright and one (light), following Genesis 1:2–3.
05:vertical-layers.texts: Gen 1:2–3; Dan 2:31–35 (the statue from head of gold to feet of clay, discussed as the same pattern)

05:mediator-human.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:mediator-human.label: Man at the center
05:mediator-human.def: The human figure who stands between heaven and earth. He brings meaning down into matter and raises matter up, uniting both in himself.
05:mediator-human.christ: Christ is the full mediator and bridge (Jonathan, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ddf-9DXASQ)

05:center-periphery.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:center-periphery.label: Center and edge
05:center-periphery.def: The world is ordered around a center of identity and meaning. Potential, chaos, the foreign and death lie toward the edge.
05:center-periphery.christ: Last Judgment imagery: “…” versus exclusion toward death (Jonathan, EP 206)

05:margin.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:margin.label: The edge / fringe
05:margin.def: The boundary zone that frames an order and marks its limit. It is linked with death, monsters, strangers, the hybrid and the left hand.

05:remainder.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:remainder.label: The residue that doesn't fit
05:remainder.def: Whatever every system leaves out: leftovers, dregs, the exception. A healthy order leaves room for it, and a totalizing order tries to abolish it.
05:remainder.texts: Lev purity laws (outside the camp), per Roberts

05:waters-of-chaos.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:waters-of-chaos.label: The deep / the sea
05:waters-of-chaos.def: Bottomless primordial waters around the land: unformed potential, chaos, death and the foreign. They return in the flood and the sea crossings.
05:waters-of-chaos.christ: Baptism is “…”. Christ stands on the gates of Hades in the icon (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ddf-9DXASQ).

05:edge-monster.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:edge-monster.label: Sea monster / creature of the outer dark
05:edge-monster.def: A dangerous creature that lives in the deep, under the ground or in the wild edge. It represents chaos that devours rather than serves.
05:edge-monster.christ: Creatures flee Christ's feet and snakes are crushed in the baptism icon (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ddf-9DXASQ)

05:cherub-hybrid.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:cherub-hybrid.label: Hybrid guardian / confusion of kinds
05:cherub-hybrid.def: A creature that mixes several kinds. It stands for the loss of clear naming after the fall and guards the boundary of paradise.
05:cherub-hybrid.christ: not stated by Matthieu (in the same exchange Peterson links the flaming sword to Christ's passion)

05:tetramorph.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:tetramorph.label: Four living creatures as a cosmos map
05:tetramorph.def: Ezekiel's creature as a vertical diagram: eagle (heaven) above, lion and bull (earth) below, and the human knower uniting them at the center.
05:tetramorph.confidence: high (Roberts calls Matthieu's chariot reading weak in its details)

05:serpent.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:serpent.label: The voice from the margin
05:serpent.def: The perspective of matter and of what is furthest from given meaning. It tempts toward grasping everything at once, and deceives.
05:serpent.christ: In the Last Judgment icon a serpent runs down from Christ to hell. In baptism icons Christ crushes snakes (Jonathan, EP 206; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ddf-9DXASQ).

05:dry-land-mountain.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:dry-land-mountain.label: Dry land as cosmic mountain
05:dry-land-mountain.def: Ordered ground raised out of the waters, best pictured as a mountain. Its summit is where heaven touches earth.
05:dry-land-mountain.texts: Gen 1:9–10; Gen 8:4; Ezek 28:13–14 (paradise as holy mountain, via Ephrem: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RXGdaJFIB8M); Exod 19, 24
05:dry-land-mountain.christ: The Ascension icon is the top of the mountain or pyramid (Jonathan, EP 206)

05:tree-of-life.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:tree-of-life.label: Central tree / axis
05:tree-of-life.def: The tree at the summit and center of paradise. It is the axis joining heaven and earth, and Christian art identifies it with the cross.

05:ladder.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:ladder.label: Serpent/ladder path of ascent and descent
05:ladder.def: A single path that runs both upward and downward between heaven and the abyss, climbed by virtue and fallen down by the passions.
05:ladder.texts: none cited (Last Judgment / Ladder of Divine Ascent iconography). The link to Jacob's ladder in Gen 28 is not confirmed in free sources.
05:ladder.christ: Christ is at the top of the Last Judgment image
05:ladder.confidence: high (for the ladder as an axis); low (for Gen 28)

05:ascent-descent.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:ascent-descent.label: Going up and going down
05:ascent-descent.def: Vertical movement. Ascent tames, gathers and approaches meaning. Descent goes into waters, earth, death, exile and the foreign.
05:ascent-descent.texts: Gen 3:23–24; Exod 19; Ps 69 (sinking into mire, the source's "powerful psalm"); 2 Kgs 2 (Elijah taken up)
05:ascent-descent.christ: Ascension as culmination of chariot ascents such as Enoch's and Elijah's (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wITJ3r96hKQ)

05:informing-descent.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:informing-descent.label: Pattern brought down from above
05:informing-descent.def: Meaning comes down from heaven and is impressed on matter: light on the waters, a name on an animal, a pattern on tabernacle materials.

05:offering-ascent.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:offering-ascent.label: Matter raised up to heaven
05:offering-ascent.def: Earthly things are lifted toward heaven through sacrifice, smoke, praise or a well-ordered body. It answers the descending pattern.

05:three-zone-sanctuary.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:three-zone-sanctuary.label: Summit, slope, foothills = Holy of Holies, Holy Place, outer court
05:three-zone-sanctuary.def: Graded holiness on paradise's mountain: tree of life at the top, tree of knowledge lower, outer slopes lowest, matching the tabernacle's three veils.

05:evening-morning.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:evening-morning.label: Potential first, then light
05:evening-morning.def: Each creative step states the lower, dark or puzzling potential first, then answers it from above with light, word and identity.
05:evening-morning.confidence: high (Jonathan); Matthieu's own detailed treatment is in the book

05:creation-days-pattern.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:creation-days-pattern.label: Days as alternating low/high, man in the middle
05:creation-days-pattern.def: The days repeat the heaven–earth pattern at each level: land then plants, lights above, fish below and birds above, then animals, man central.

05:creature-hierarchy.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:creature-hierarchy.label: Birds, livestock, wild beasts, creepers, fish, sea monsters
05:creature-hierarchy.def: Animals ranked by closeness to human meaning: birds high and spiritual, livestock near humans, wild beasts outside, creepers and fish hidden in darkness.
05:creature-hierarchy.christ: Christ and the church as fishers who draw life out of the dark (Jonathan)

05:naming-judging.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:naming-judging.label: See, name, judge
05:naming-judging.def: Something appears as a puzzle, light identifies it, speech names it, and judgment declares it good, bringing it into ordered participation.
05:naming-judging.texts: Gen 1:3–4 ("God saw that it was good"); Gen 2:19–20

05:premature-integration.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:premature-integration.label: Grasping everything at once
05:premature-integration.def: The serpent's temptation is to take in total knowledge immediately rather than gradually. It ends in wrongful incorporation, nakedness and expulsion.

05:fall-into-multiplicity.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:fall-into-multiplicity.label: Down the mountain into the many
05:fall-into-multiplicity.def: Transgression leads to expulsion downward and outward, from paradise's unity to scattered multiplicity, adding layers of covering and duality at each step.
05:fall-into-multiplicity.texts: Gen 3:22–24; Gen 4:8–17 (Cain repeats the fall "at a lower and more explicit level"); Gen 11:1–9

05:garments-of-skin.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:garments-of-skin.label: Protective covering of death
05:garments-of-skin.def: The covering God gives after the fall, a layer of death protecting against death. It extends to hair, clothing, tools, law and the city.
05:garments-of-skin.texts: Gen 3:21; Exod 26:14 (skin coverings of the tabernacle, via Gregory of Nyssa); 2 Kgs 1:8 and 2:13 (Elijah's hairy mantle passed to Elisha)
05:garments-of-skin.christ: Gregory of Nyssa's removal of the garments in the ascent to God (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yo8TrzRm6J4); see `death-into-glory`

05:hair-glory.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:hair-glory.label: Hair as death and glory
05:hair-glory.def: Hair is dead, external growth that protects and also shines. It joins death and glory, power and covering.
05:hair-glory.christ: The returning Christ's white hair (Rev 1:14) as death and glory together (Jonathan)

05:garment-fringe.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:garment-fringe.label: Woven order with a loose edge
05:garment-fringe.def: A garment's tight weave is integrated order and work, and its fringe is the permitted margin of looseness, exception and time.
05:garment-fringe.texts: none cited by Roberts (Num 15:38 is the obvious candidate, not source-confirmed)

05:city.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:city.label: Built order of the exiles
05:city.def: An artificial social covering built by those cast out (Cain, Ham, Nimrod). It joins power and technology with an increase of the curse.

05:garden.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:garden.label: Paradise as ordered center
05:garden.def: The original enclosed holy place, a mountain with the tree at the summit and rivers flowing down, where heaven and earth are balanced in Adam.

05:new-jerusalem.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:new-jerusalem.label: City with the garden at its center
05:new-jerusalem.def: The final form of the whole pattern: a perfected city descending from heaven, containing the restored garden and tree at its center.

05:head-crown.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:head-crown.label: Head as principle, crown as what rises above it
05:head-crown.def: The head is the first principle giving meaning to the body. A crown is a transformation set above the head, extending it without destroying it.
05:head-crown.texts: Gen 1:1 (bereshit / rosh); Prov 12:4 (implied by "woman crowning her husband")

05:heart-center.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:heart-center.label: Heart as meeting point of head and body
05:heart-center.def: The chest or heart where the head's principle and the body's strength meet. It is the human microcosm's center.

05:right-left-hand.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:right-left-hand.label: Right (blessing, tight order) / left (loose, marginal)
05:right-left-hand.def: The right hand means blessing and tight integration of mind and body. The left means looseness, play, weakness, the margin, the set-aside.
05:right-left-hand.christ: In icons, Christ's right hand blesses Abel (Jonathan)

05:dove-and-raven.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:dove-and-raven.label: Bird that finds the pattern / bird of the residue
05:dove-and-raven.def: The heavenly bird sent over the chaos waters finds new land and brings back the pattern. The dark bird stays with the old world's remains.
05:dove-and-raven.christ: At the baptism the Spirit descends “…” (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ddf-9DXASQ)

05:ark-vessel.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:ark-vessel.label: Vessel through the waters of death
05:ark-vessel.def: The container that carries the righteous remnant through the chaos waters. Early Christians drew it like a coffin, paired with Jonah's fish.
05:ark-vessel.christ: via the catacomb pairing with Jonah and baptism as descent (Jonathan)

05:waters-passage.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:waters-passage.label: Descent into waters, rising, heaven opens
05:waters-passage.def: A chosen one goes through the waters of death and comes up onto land. Heaven opens, spirit or word descends, and creation is renewed.
05:waters-passage.texts: Gen 1:2–10; Gen 6–9; Exod 2:1–10, 14–15; Josh 3; 2 Kgs 2:8, 6:6 (floating axe head); Jonah 2; Matt 3:16–17

05:male-female.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:male-female.label: Heaven/earth at human scale
05:male-female.def: Man and woman repeat heaven and earth: male as seed or principle, female as body, food or earth. Woman also mediates with the margin.
05:male-female.christ: not stated by Matthieu (Roberts notes women at Christ's death and resurrection)

05:earthly-brother-heavenly-brother.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:earthly-brother-heavenly-brother.label: Power vs authority brothers
05:earthly-brother-heavenly-brother.def: Paired brothers: an earthly one (farmer, hunter, king, "power") and a heavenly one (shepherd, priest, "authority"). Their conflict repeats Cain and Abel.
05:earthly-brother-heavenly-brother.texts: Gen 4:1–16; Gen 10:8–9; Gen 25:27–34; Gen 27; Gen 37–50 (Joseph/Judah, which Roberts finds unpersuasive)
05:earthly-brother-heavenly-brother.christ: The clip “…” exists but was not checked (see Sources)

05:marginal-hairy-man.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:marginal-hairy-man.label: Covered, wild figure on the edge (Cain, Esau, Nimrod, Elijah)
05:marginal-hairy-man.def: A strong figure marked by hair or skins, living at the edge (hunter, wanderer, prophet), who carries the garments of skin. Ambivalent: power or witness.
05:marginal-hairy-man.texts: Gen 25:25, 27:11–23; Gen 10:8–9; 2 Kgs 1:8; Matt 3:4 (John the Baptist is our extension, not from the source)

05:marked-exile.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:marked-exile.label: The scapegoat cast to the edge
05:marked-exile.def: A figure expelled and marked as outside, who wanders in hostile land. The exclusion also founds identity and builds a city.

05:edge-craftsman.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:edge-craftsman.label: Smith/technician of the dark edge
05:edge-craftsman.def: The maker or smith tied to the underground and the marginal (Cain's line, Hephaestus, dwarves). He gathers dark potential into tools and weapons.

05:fool.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:fool.label: The inversion figure
05:fool.def: A marginal, upside-down figure who exposes the king's nakedness. In the positive case (David), he is the low one raised up, foreshadowing Christ's reversal.
05:fool.texts: 1 Sam 21:10–15 (David feigns madness, implied); David narratives generally

05:carnival-inversion.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:carnival-inversion.label: Licensed upside-down time, then death and order
05:carnival-inversion.def: For a set time the margin takes the center (masks, noise, monsters, a mock king), ending in humiliation, death or fasting, then restored order.
05:carnival-inversion.texts: none biblical in source (Feast of the Ass tied to the flight into Egypt)

05:two-judgments.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:two-judgments.label: Tyranny of total order / chaos of total mixing
05:two-judgments.def: Two opposite failures each bring judgment: rigid false integration that excludes all remainder (Babel), or boundary-dissolving mixture that floods everything (pre-flood).

05:time-space.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:time-space.label: Flood/time vs dry land/space
05:time-space.def: Time is the changing, dissolving, renewing force (waters, wheel, rest). Space is the stabilizing, structuring force (dry land, pillar, work).
05:time-space.confidence: medium (Roberts thinks the dichotomy is overstated)

05:sabbath.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:sabbath.label: Seventh day joining time and space
05:sabbath.def: The seventh day, rest after six days of work. It reconciles change with stability, and in Matthieu's reading the Queen of Sheba corresponds to it.
05:sabbath.texts: Gen 2:1–3; 1 Kgs 5–10 (King of Tyre as the six days, Queen of Sheba as the seventh)

05:bread-and-wine.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:bread-and-wine.label: Work and rest
05:bread-and-wine.def: Bread is ordered strength for work at the day's start. Wine is loosening and gladness at the day's end, tied to blood and rest.

05:north-south.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:north-south.label: Heights of seed / depths of sustenance
05:north-south.def: Biblical geography read vertically: north as heights (Japheth, Laban, white, new seed), south as depths (Ham, Edom, red, food), Shem between.
05:north-south.confidence: medium (Roberts: "thought-provoking and perhaps a bit controversial")

05:death-into-glory.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:death-into-glory.label: The great reversal
05:death-into-glory.def: At the fall glory turned into death. Through humility (David) and finally Christ, death is turned back into glory.
05:death-into-glory.christ: The cross is both the lowest and the highest point, death and glory together (Jonathan)

05:heaven-earth-union.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:heaven-earth-union.label: Restoration as reunion in the mediator
05:heaven-earth-union.def: After separation and fall, heaven and earth are rejoined in a mediating figure or place. Ultimately this happens in Christ and the descending city.
05:heaven-earth-union.texts: Gen 1:26–27; Gen 28:12 (not source-confirmed); Matt 3:16–17; John 1:51 (not source-confirmed); Rev 21–22

05:nonidentical-repetition.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:nonidentical-repetition.label: Same shape, new key
05:nonidentical-repetition.def: A pattern recurs in a later event, changed by its new place in time. A type and its antitype are similar but never identical.
05:nonidentical-repetition.christ: Christ is the fulfilment that every repetition leads toward (Leithart, “…”)

05:creation-decreation-recreation.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:creation-decreation-recreation.label: The Bible's main rhythm
05:creation-decreation-recreation.def: An ordered world is made, corrupts and is undone (flood, plague, exile), then a new world is formed through a chosen person or remnant.
05:creation-decreation-recreation.texts: Gen 1; Gen 6–9; Exod 1–15; the exile and return; Acts 2 (the church, as Antlitz describes Leithart's table)
05:creation-decreation-recreation.christ: Christ's death and resurrection is the fulfilment (Leithart)

05:priest-king-prophet.work: Jonathan & Matthieu Pageau, Peter Leithart: free public talks, essays and reviews
05:priest-king-prophet.label: Stages of maturity
05:priest-king-prophet.def: Humanity and Israel mature from priestly obedience to kingly rule to prophetic counsel, a pattern also found in single lives and crafts.
05:priest-king-prophet.texts: Exod 19:6; 1 Sam 8–16; Kings and Prophets; Eph 4:7–16

06:heaven.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:heaven.label: 'heaven' (upper half of the cosmos)
06:heaven.def: The upper, spiritual half of reality: pure meaning without body, the source of identity, principle and light.

06:earth.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:earth.label: 'earth' (lower half of the cosmos)
06:earth.def: The lower, bodily half of reality: matter without meaning, dark enigmas waiting to host and express a principle.

06:knowledge.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:knowledge.label: union of heaven and earth
06:knowledge.def: Heaven covering earth with meaning while earth supports and expresses heaven; Pageau's basic pattern behind every phenomenon.

06:lowering-meaning.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:lowering-meaning.label: materialization
06:lowering-meaning.def: A heavenly seed comes down and is made tangible: breath into word, dew into frost, flour into bread, name into laws.

06:raising-matter.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:raising-matter.label: refinement
06:raising-matter.def: Earthly matter is chosen, cleaned, cooked and offered upward so it can host or feed a spirit.

06:light.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:light.label: 'light'
06:light.def: Meaning made explicit; the principle that answers the enigma of matter. Created by God's first spoken word.

06:darkness.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:darkness.label: 'darkness'
06:darkness.def: Matter cut off from a principle: an obscure question that can still host meaning once answered.

06:seed.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:seed.label: 'seed' / point of wisdom
06:seed.def: A minimal, point-like principle that implicitly contains everything; a promise of future fruit; Pageau's closest tangible picture of heaven.
06:seed.texts: Prov 4:7; Gen 1:11-12; Gen 18:10 (promise); Ex 16:31 (manna like coriander seed); Gen 28:14
06:seed.christ: None in this book. (Inferred: Gen 3:15 “…” is cited in ch. 59 and 80 only as the space/time tug-of-war.)

06:flesh.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:flesh.label: 'flesh' / meat
06:flesh.def: The earthly counterpart of seed: matter that details, supports and "fleshes out" a principle; food that rises in the evening.

06:manna.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:manna.label: bread from heaven
06:manna.def: Descending, seed-like, bright "spiritual nutrition"; meaning becoming matter. Its name means "what?" (essence).
06:manna.christ: None in this book. (Inferred, not Pageau: John 6.)

06:bread.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:bread.label: bread (and later, leavened bread)
06:bread.def: Meaning materialized at the human scale (flour, then dough, then bread). In Part V it also stands for worked, fire-fixed space as opposed to wine.

06:adam-mediator.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:adam-mediator.label: Adam / the human as mediator
06:adam-mediator.def: Humanity's cosmic job: standing between heaven and earth, lowering meaning and raising matter so that God is known in creation.

06:meta-knowledge.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:meta-knowledge.label: image of God / knowledge of the Creator
06:meta-knowledge.def: A knowledge above ordinary symbols, by which the Creator of heaven and earth is known inside creation. Adam embodies it.

06:vertical-layers.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:vertical-layers.label: light, air, water, earth
06:vertical-layers.def: Vertical space ranked by density and brightness: the higher, the rarer, clearer and simpler; the lower, the heavier, darker and more common.

06:center.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:center.label: the center / middle
06:center.def: Where heaven and earth truly meet: knowledge that is neither too simple nor too complex; the stable middle of the world (Canaan, the garden's tree).

06:wisdom.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:wisdom.label: wisdom
06:wisdom.def: The first principle or cosmic seed, the plan of the house, the principle of work that founds stable space.

06:understanding.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:understanding.label: understanding
06:understanding.def: The power that unfolds wisdom's seed into details and builds it out, like soil developing a seed ("stretching out the heavens").

06:pillars-of-the-earth.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:pillars-of-the-earth.label: paired opposite pillars
06:pillars-of-the-earth.def: Supports that hold up a spiritual principle, usually paired as opposites to give the widest base for knowledge.

06:house.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:house.label: house / building
06:house.def: Built space as a small copy of creation: the roof is heaven, the base is earth, the plan is lowered and materials are raised.

06:breath.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:breath.label: breath / spirit / wind
06:breath.def: Heaven at the human scale: the wind of God becomes Adam's breath, which carries speech, names and identity.

06:dust-body.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:dust-body.label: dust / body
06:dust-body.def: Earth at the human scale: dust raised into a body that supports and expresses the breath; also a raised population (Israel).

06:head.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:head.label: head / chief
06:head.def: The first principle in a body, a society or an empire; the source of meaning that answers the body's dark needs, while the limbs give power.

06:rider-and-mount.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:rider-and-mount.label: rider and mount
06:rider-and-mount.def: Spirit directing power: the rider gives purpose and the mount gives strength. A fallen rider means the hierarchy is overturned.

06:angel.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:angel.label: angel / messenger
06:angel.def: A heavenly carrier of meaning and guidance to humans; to be hosted and fed. Hosted wrongly, angels fall.

06:animal.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:animal.label: beast (to be named)
06:animal.def: Earthly life below humanity that receives its identity from Adam; to be named, tamed and eaten. Also the body's own "animal component".

06:naming.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:naming.label: naming
06:naming.def: Lowering heaven into earth through breath: giving a creature its spiritual identity. It goes with eating and taming.

06:eating.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:eating.label: eating / integrating
06:eating.def: Knowledge as a head integrating matter into its body. Eating the right food builds the body; eating the wrong food splits it.

06:male.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:male.label: male
06:male.def: Heaven at the scale of sex: the giver of seed and language. In time/space terms, the one who "fixes" the cycle and builds space.

06:female.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:female.label: female / Eve
06:female.def: Earth at the scale of sex: she raises food from her body to flesh out the seed. In time/space terms, the cycle of renewal and recreation.

06:earthly-twin.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:earthly-twin.label: farmer, king, builder (Cain, Esau, Ham)
06:earthly-twin.def: Adam specialized toward earth: the power that holds land, builds cities and forges tools. He should host the heavenly twin, but often kills or exposes him.

06:heavenly-twin.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:heavenly-twin.label: shepherd, priest (Abel, Jacob, Shem)
06:heavenly-twin.def: Adam specialized toward heaven: contemplative authority that offers refined flesh. Without the earthly twin he is "just breath" (Abel = vanity).

06:restored-image.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:restored-image.label: third son / renewed Adam (Seth, Shem, Jacob)
06:restored-image.def: The figure who recovers Adam's image by joining heavenly authority with an earthly inheritance, and who restores balance after the twins' conflict.

06:tithe.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:tithe.label: tithe / raised offering
06:tithe.def: Matter and power sent up from below to support the head: taxes to the altar or the priesthood.

06:anointing.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:anointing.label: anointing with oil
06:anointing.def: Meaning and authority poured down from above; oil makes matter shine, reflecting light.
06:anointing.christ: None in this book. (Inferred, not Pageau: “…” means anointed.)

06:altar.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:altar.label: altar / hearth
06:altar.def: The east side of the temple, where flesh is consumed and raised as smoke in exchange for light. At home, the hearth is a fire-pillar against night and wilderness.

06:tent.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:tent.label: tent of meeting / tabernacle and ark
06:tent.def: The west side of the temple, where breath becomes matter: showbread hosts it, the menorah sends out light, and the ark in the west hosts God's presence.
06:tent.texts: Ex 25-29; Gen 18:6, 9 (Sarah in the tent); Gen 9:21

06:cherub.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:cherub.label: cherub / living creature
06:cherub.def: God's mount and support. As a hybrid sphinx it guards an unanswered enigma; as a square tetramorph it hosts the answered one.

06:lion-and-bull.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:lion-and-bull.label: lion and bull/ox
06:lion-and-bull.def: The dichotomy beneath the cherub: the lion eats the bull, and the bull becomes the lion's body. Two faces of one exchange (altar and tent, sun and moon).

06:north.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:north.label: north / heights
06:north.def: Symbolic height: heaven, white, snowy Lebanon, kin and the source of identity or seed. One goes up north for one's origins.

06:south.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:south.label: south / depths (Egypt, Edom, Sheol)
06:south.def: Symbolic depth: earth, red, Egypt, the underworld. One goes down south to gain food, population and goods.

06:four-directions.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:four-directions.label: the four quarters / six directions
06:four-directions.def: Space set up by separating opposites: up from down, east from west, north from south. Squared space branches from a central axis in four directions.
06:four-directions.texts: Gen 2:10 (four heads of the river); Gen 28:14; Ezek 1 (four faces, four wings); Num 2 (camp)

06:ladder.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:ladder.label: Jacob's ladder
06:ladder.def: The vertical bridge between heaven and earth where messengers go up and down, exchanging authority for power. It is the spatial axis that branches into four directions.
06:ladder.christ: None in this book. (Inferred, not Pageau: John 1:51.)

06:name-of-god.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:name-of-god.label: the Name, "I am what I am"
06:name-of-god.def: The clearest seed in the Bible: a tautology that contains all law in principle and that defines space itself ("I am on earth what I am in heaven").

06:law.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:law.label: Mosaic Law
06:law.def: The Name branching into specific cases, as a tree grows from a seed. Laws are positive or negative statements of the "law of space".

06:covenant.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:covenant.label: covenant
06:covenant.def: An agreement between heaven and earth, or between space and time: words matched by deeds. It comes in two kinds, rectification (circumcision) and renewal (Sabbath, rainbow).

06:time.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:time.label: 'time'
06:time.def: The cosmic cause of cyclical change that turns things into their opposites. It brings death and renewal, and holds the periphery against space.

06:space.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:space.label: 'space'
06:space.def: The stabilizing power that holds opposites apart and makes a center where facts match meaning. It is built by work and law.

06:evening-and-morning.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:evening-and-morning.label: evening and morning
06:evening-and-morning.def: The first day's rhythm: light goes down into darkness (evening) and is raised again (morning). Flesh comes in the evening and bread in the morning. (Inferred pairing of ch. 16 and ch. 31.)

06:waters.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:waters.label: 'waters' / flooded land
06:waters.def: The fluid medium of change and confusion between meaning and fact; the first stage of creation and what the flood brings back. Any liquid counts.

06:dry-land.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:dry-land.label: dry land
06:dry-land.def: Space achieved: a stable place where heaven and earth agree, theory matches practice, and God is revealed directly.

06:margins.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:margins.label: periphery / margins / edge
06:margins.def: The unstable ring around stable space where strange and ironic things happen: the sea, wilderness, fringes, gleanings, outsiders.
06:margins.texts: Gen 1:9; Deut 22:12; Lev 19:9-10; Josh 2:15 (house in the wall); 1 Kgs 4:29 (sea-shore)

06:spatial-axis.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:spatial-axis.label: cosmic tree / pillar of space
06:spatial-axis.def: The central pillar that separates above from below and the four directions, and grows consistently from one seed into fruit "according to its kind".
06:spatial-axis.texts: Gen 1:11-12; Gen 2:9; Gen 18:8 (tree at Mamre); Gen 28:12; Dan 4:10-12

06:cosmic-mountain.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:cosmic-mountain.label: the cosmic mountain
06:cosmic-mountain.def: The spatial axis in the landscape: a high, stable center that resists the flood and from which space is refounded or law comes down.

06:axle-of-time.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:axle-of-time.label: axle / wheel / dark pillar
06:axle-of-time.def: The hidden, non-manifest link between heaven and earth that secretly turns the wheel of fortune; a "tree of death" or negative pillar.

06:foundation-stone.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:foundation-stone.label: foundation stone
06:foundation-stone.def: The first principle by which all matter in a space is ordered: a familiar cause of certainty and stability.

06:stumbling-stone.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:stumbling-stone.label: stumbling / scandal stone
06:stumbling-stone.def: The irregular, uncut, alien fact that cannot be integrated and brings the edifice down. It destroys, but it also forces renewal.
06:stumbling-stone.christ: None in this book. (Inferred, not Pageau: Isa 8:14 and 1 Pet 2:8.)

06:pinnacle-stone.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:pinnacle-stone.label: pinnacle / head-of-corner stone
06:pinnacle-stone.def: The rejected stone made the top principle of a meta-space. It unites the foundation stone and the stumbling stone as the one principle of all creation.
06:pinnacle-stone.christ: None in this book. (Inferred, not Pageau: Matt 21:42 applies Ps 118:22 to Christ.)

06:remainder.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:remainder.label: remainder / leftover
06:remainder.def: Whatever a space cannot integrate: by-products of work, anomalies and outcasts. It is exiled to the margins, returns with the flood, or crowns a meta-space.
06:remainder.texts: Lev 16 (scapegoat to Azazel); Dan 3 (the three in the furnace); Dan 4:27 (the poor); Lev 19:9-10

06:stranger.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:stranger.label: stranger / other / foreigner
06:stranger.def: The flip side of a revealed identity: whatever does not express the Name. It is a carrier of transformation (spies, foreign nations, strange gods).

06:mixture.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:mixture.label: mixture / impurity / hybridization
06:mixture.def: Taking in elements foreign to an identity or confusing opposites. Each step yields "less of itself, more of the other" and summons the flood.

06:splitting-waters.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:splitting-waters.label: separating / establishing space
06:splitting-waters.def: Holding opposites apart by removing the intermediate states, so that certainty replaces confusion. Any separation (milk from meat, linen from wool) "establishes space".
06:splitting-waters.texts: Gen 1:6-10; Prov 3:20; Ex 14:16-22; Josh 3 (inferred: Pageau does not cite the Jordan)

06:giants.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:giants.label: Nephilim / giants
06:giants.def: The offspring of angels wrongly hosted: a head too high on a body too low. Brute, undivided, hybrid; they are omens of the flood.

06:divination.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:divination.label: divination / "snake knowledge"
06:divination.def: Indirect knowledge read off fluid media (water, dreams, lots, games of chance, the dead). It is used where law does not reach and is risky because it submits to time.
06:divination.texts: Lev 19:26; Num 12:6-8; Gen 8:7-12; Urim and Thummim

06:square.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:square.label: square / cornered shape
06:square.def: Shapes with points and corners show a revealed inner point made explicit: stable, certain space (altar, ark, tablets, camp).
06:square.texts: Ezek 1 (four-cornered creatures); Ex 25-27; Num 2; Deut 22:12 (four corners)

06:cycle.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:cycle.label: cycle / wave / circle / ouroboros
06:cycle.def: A pointless, self-negating return: inverting an inversion goes back to the start (-(-1) = +1). It is figured as a snake eating its tail and as self-cannibalism.

06:work.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:work.label: work
06:work.def: Building space: carrying out a plan in matter and integrating raw matter into familiar order. It is tiring, artificial and productive.

06:rest.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:rest.label: rest / idleness / sleep
06:rest.def: Letting things slide back toward primitive conditions (wilderness, flood, sleep, death). It is destructive and also re-creative.

06:tool.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:tool.label: tool / pointed implement
06:tool.def: The active spatial axis in small: a pointed instrument that "focuses power to distribute a point" and rectifies matter (nail, needle, plow, yoke, pen, spear).

06:musical-instrument.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:musical-instrument.label: horn, trumpet, harp
06:musical-instrument.def: The active axle of time: the hollowed, curved, "pointless" horn and all music that makes the world turn and dance. It brings rest, sleep and death, and also reawakening.

06:fool.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:fool.label: fool / jester / clown
06:fool.def: Time as a human type: idle, playful, deceiving, inverting. He "eats his own flesh" and loosens what is bound, which brings both ruin and renewal.

06:six.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:six.label: the number six
06:six.def: Work, measurement and rationality: six days, six directions, the sides of a cube. It is the count of a circle measured by its radius before the remainder.
06:six.texts: Ex 20:9; Deut 5:13; Dan 3:1 (60 x 6 cubits); Josh 6:3

06:seven.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:seven.label: the number seven
06:seven.def: The cycle's natural law: the leftover beyond six, the irrational moment when the end becomes a new beginning (Sabbath, release, the fall of walls).

06:jubilee.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:jubilee.label: Jubilee (7 x 7, then 50)
06:jubilee.def: The largest nested rest: after seven sabbatical weeks of years, a horn proclaims release, freed slaves and land returned. It is a controlled flood.

06:zero-and-one.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:zero-and-one.label: 0 and 1, minus and plus
06:zero-and-one.def: Zero (naught, the restart of the count) stands for time; one stands for space. Minus and plus are their signs, and +1 - 1 = 0 is life under time.

06:sabbath.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:sabbath.label: Sabbath
06:sabbath.def: The covenant of peace between space and time (land and sea): rest without total flood, and work without total control. It is the place that can host the Creator.

06:meta-space.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:meta-space.label: meta-space / higher space
06:meta-space.def: Space raised by including a measured portion of time. It can host the single principle of time and space, straight and crooked, known and hidden.

06:ornament.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:ornament.label: ornament / seal / crown / fringe / spice
06:ornament.def: The final touch that keeps a little wildness at the edge of finished work. It seals out the flood while refusing total rationalization (vines, tzitzit, jewels, salt).
06:ornament.texts: Gen 2:2; Deut 22:12; Num 15:38; 1 Kgs 10:2, 10; Gen 4:19 (Adah = ornament)

06:fire.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:fire.label: fire
06:fire.def: Artificial, rigorous power that cuts through confusion and dries the land. Its extreme form is judgment, the opposite extreme to the flood.

06:garden.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:garden.label: the Garden of Eden
06:garden.def: A small copy of the cosmos in perfect balance: a tree and a snake, four rivers squaring the flow. It is kept by light work and light preserving.

06:snake.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:snake.label: snake / serpent
06:snake.def: Time in the garden: subtle, naked, fluid and cyclical. It carries strange knowledge and toxins, eats dust, and bites the heel.
06:snake.christ: None in this book. (Inferred, not Pageau: John 3:14 and Num 21.)

06:tree-of-life.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:tree-of-life.label: tree of life
06:tree-of-life.def: The spatial pillar in the garden: solid, dressed, discrete. It grows from one seed and produces familiar food.

06:tree-of-knowledge.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:tree-of-knowledge.label: tree of the knowledge of good and bad
06:tree-of-knowledge.def: A tree that holds both a good (space) and a bad (time) mediator, like Gerizim and Ebal. Resolved, its bad is changed into a higher good and life.

06:blood.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:blood.label: blood
06:blood.def: Time in the body: a flowing liquid that heals and renews. Shed or eaten, it is a small flood (Abel's blood, menstruation, raw meat).

06:bones.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:bones.label: bones
06:bones.def: Space in the body: dry, white pillars that keep the body upright, said to come from the father's seed.

06:left-and-right.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:left-and-right.label: left hand and right hand (and eyes)
06:left-and-right.def: Right is the body carrying out the mind accurately (space). Left is clumsy, loose and marginal (time). Society repeats the split in its marginal groups.
06:left-and-right.texts: Eccl 10:2; Gen 2:15; Ezek 1:10 (lion right, bull left)

06:sin.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:sin.label: sin
06:sin.def: Joining heaven and earth wrongly: failing to host God's breath (disobedience) and failing to integrate matter (bad food). It happens inside and outside at once.

06:foreign-food.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:foreign-food.label: forbidden / unclean food, intoxication
06:foreign-food.def: Matter the identity cannot integrate. It becomes rebel members in the body and splits head from body ("intoxication"); kosher food is its opposite.

06:nakedness.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:nakedness.label: nakedness / falling
06:nakedness.def: Uncovered flesh: the visible gap between meaning and body, together with the fall of the body's hierarchy. It is a return to raw nature and to death.
06:nakedness.texts: Gen 2:25, 3:7-10; Gen 9:21-23; Gen 42:9 ("nakedness of the land")

06:clothing.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:clothing.label: clothing / dressing
06:clothing.def: Space at the scale of the body: an artificial cover that straightens the flesh to obey the head. It ranges from uniform (square) to disguise (time) to fringed garment (balance).

06:exile.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:exile.label: exile / wandering / losing the land
06:exile.def: Space giving way to time at the human scale: losing guidance, then support, then the land, and wandering among strangers and strange gods.

06:homeland.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:homeland.label: homeland / familiar space
06:homeland.def: Dry land at the human scale: the inherited land where law, purity and identity hold. You keep it by keeping the laws of space.

06:dream.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:dream.label: sleep / dream
06:dream.def: Internal exile: the head loses hold of the body, the identity sinks into strange flesh, and then (ideally) rises renewed.

06:staff.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:staff.label: staff / rod
06:staff.def: The cosmic pillar in a hand. It holds space up, leads home from exile and splits waters; released, it becomes a snake.

06:pillar-of-cloud-and-fire.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:pillar-of-cloud-and-fire.label: pillar of cloud and fire
06:pillar-of-cloud-and-fire.def: God's pillar going ahead of Israel. It separates Israel from Egypt, balances day heat and night cold, and fixes the camp, foursquare, around itself.

06:disease.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:disease.label: disease / tzaraath
06:disease.def: Time at the human scale: identity losing its grip on the flesh, which unravels body, garment or house. It is cleansed by a cycle (seven days outside).

06:eyes.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:eyes.label: eyes (right eye / left eye)
06:eyes.def: Knowledge as an emitted light that names things. The right eye identifies (space); the left eye wonders, sees strangeness and divines (time).

06:grace.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:grace.label: grace
06:grace.def: Perfect balance of consistency (righteousness) and completeness (perfection) between space and time. It is what qualifies Noah to come through the flood.

06:raven.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:raven.label: raven
06:raven.def: A dark, unclean, carrion bird: strange flesh, death and cyclical time. As Noah's "eye" it never brings back a positive sign.

06:dove.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:dove.label: dove
06:dove.def: A clean, familiar, message-carrying bird, like an angel. It brings back the olive leaf, a piece of the spatial axis, as a sign that dry land has returned.
06:dove.christ: None in this book. (Inferred, not Pageau: the dove at Jesus' baptism, Matt 3:16.)

06:cooking.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:cooking.label: cooking / fixing raw flesh
06:cooking.def: Fire turning bloody, flooded flesh into "dry" food the body can integrate; in society, blood feud becomes fixed law.

06:blood-vengeance.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:blood-vengeance.label: blood vengeance / law of return
06:blood-vengeance.def: Primitive justice by return, with no fixed law: an endless feud loop. It protects and dooms Cain at once, and Lamech brings it to seventy-sevenfold.

06:wine.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:wine.label: wine / fermentation
06:wine.def: Time as a drink: a mild poison taken for rest and renewal. It reproduces flood, exile and nakedness in small, and stands opposite bread.

06:rainbow.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:rainbow.label: rainbow / bow in the cloud
06:rainbow.def: A bridge between heaven and earth and between rain and clear sky. It is also a covenant of renewal and an ornamental "crown" on God's finished work.

06:familiar-woman.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:familiar-woman.label: the familiar woman / wife
06:familiar-woman.def: A woman of the same law and people who reproduces the male's identity faithfully, giving consistent offspring. She is space in sexuality (Zillah).

06:strange-woman.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:strange-woman.label: the strange woman / harlot
06:strange-woman.def: A foreign, unbound woman who does not reproduce the seed faithfully. She means ruin and also renewal (Adah, Rahab, Tamar, Sheba).

06:crimson-thread.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:crimson-thread.label: scarlet thread (with spies)
06:crimson-thread.def: A loose, red thread at the edge of the city: a secret pact and a fringe through which time gets in and unravels space. Spies are its agents.

06:walled-city.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:walled-city.label: walled city
06:walled-city.def: Artificial space at the communal scale, built against the wilderness. Circling, horns and spies (time) bring its walls down.

06:flood.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:flood.label: the flood
06:flood.def: De-creation: time swallowing space, and a negation of what God made. It is caused by hybridization and failed mediation and ends with refounding on a mountain.

06:fall.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:fall.label: the fall
06:fall.def: The first wrong union: eating what cannot be named or integrated, which opens the eyes to nakedness and leads to artificial covering, death and exile.

06:writing.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:writing.label: writing / mark / tablets
06:writing.def: Marks that physically host meaning, the model for all symbols. As Cain's mark it is wisdom frozen once living mediation is lost; as square tablets it is fixed law.

06:vine-and-fig-tree.work: Matthieu Pageau, The Language of Creation (2018)
06:vine-and-fig-tree.label: vine and fig tree
06:vine-and-fig-tree.def: Under Solomon, every man sits under his vine (time) and his fig tree (space, the leaves of the first clothing). It is Pageau's summary image of balance.
